reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary user-facing purpose is converting image inputs into text through an external vision service, with optional image generation and caching.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 中的纯文本模型提供图片识别转文字能力，并可通过外部视觉服务生成图片。
summaries.en: Enables image-to-text understanding for text-only DSH models and optionally generates images through an external vision service.

capabilities: Reads image attachments and embedded image blocks
Sends image data to a configured external vision API for description or OCR-style processing
Replaces image inputs with generated text before sending requests to text-only models
Optionally calls an external image-generation API and saves generated images as attachments
Caches recognition results in memory and on local storage
